﻿﻿This mod adds 50+ beautiful outdoor items (can also be used indoors!) for you to decorate,
house and unleash the romanticism with this classical set. This furniture set was made to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14442]Yri's Romantic Farm[/url],
using some of Yri's assets with her express permission. ﻿
[size=2]
[b] Different Color Schemes Available Via Config![/b]
Choose from: Marble, Yri, Goth, Pastel and Mermaid!

This is all new furniture using Content Patcher!
You can find the furniture either using something like CJB Item Spawner
OR you can purchase the brand new Romantic Furniture Catalogue from Robin's Shop!
[/size]
